positive friction coefficient and tangential stiffness

no mid-Newton restart

no global pressure-coupled tangent-consistency claim
no complete global energy-decomposition claim

open_decisions.title: Bounded J2 plus geometric formulation
open_decisions.decision_required_before: WP09 implementation or any public J2-plus-geometry claim
open_decisions.question: Which physical formulation is acceptable for a bounded J2 plus geometric-nonlinear scope?

options.name: Corotational / large-rotation plus small-strain J2
options.scope: Potentially bounded large-rotation engineering model; requires explicit stress/strain and state-transport limits.

options.name: Existing total_lagrangian_j2 research formulation
options.scope: Research continuation only until the physical formulation and validation basis are independently reviewed.

options.name: Finite-strain multiplicative plasticity F = Fe Fp
options.scope: Most physically complete option; substantial new formulation and verification work, not selected by default.

options.name: Defer public J2 plus geometry claim
options.scope: Keep work research-only or out of release scope.

open_decisions.title: Legacy v1 checkpoint compatibility boundary
open_decisions.question: Should legacy schema-1 checkpoints with contact-bearing models receive a migration path despite schema 1 lacking contact state, topology and composite digests?
open_decisions.decision_scope: Read contact-free v1 checkpoints and stateless-compatible penalty-contact v1 checkpoints only when compatibility is proven from the current model; reject ambiguous/stateful contact-history-dependent v1 checkpoints; never invent missing history; write v2 only.
open_decisions.default_without_owner_approval: Reject ambiguous contact-bearing v1 checkpoints explicitly; support bounded contact-free v1 read and v2 write.

options.name: Keep bounded compatibility
options.scope: Read v1 only for contact-free/stateless-compatible cases; reject ambiguous contact-bearing v1 inputs explicitly.

options.name: Add a legacy contact migration contract
options.scope: Define and validate an external topology/invariant source before accepting contact-bearing v1 checkpoints.

options.name: Reject all v1 checkpoints
options.scope: Require a v2 checkpoint for every restart; this would be a deliberate compatibility break.

open_decisions.blocks: Only the ambiguous contact-bearing v1 migration path; it does not block WP02-B bounded schema foundation or later fixed-state work within the approved policy.
